# Aman Mulani

AI & Full-Stack Engineer based in India. Building software professionally since August 2022.

## Experience

- THG Ingenuity — Software Engineer, AI & Full-Stack, August 2025–present. Built and maintained an AI Shopping Assistant across 10+ ecommerce brands, owning the agent backend, client SDK, and UI integration with Google ADK, AG-UI, and FastAPI. Reduced assistant costs by $4,000+ per month. Built a tenant-specific Assistant Console, RAG applications, a multimodal AI Stylist, automation, and a multi-tenant CMS. Deployed assistant services on Google Cloud Run.
- Razorpay — Product Engineer, Full-Stack, April 2024–August 2025. Built a configuration-driven push provisioning platform and Python/FastAPI services for secure card tokenization and lifecycle management. Delivered React, TypeScript, API, and database features with automated and integration tests, CI/CD, and monitoring.
- HMX Media — Web Developer, August 2022–March 2024. Built localization automation tools, reusable React components, and interactive Canvas/WebGL experiences.

## Personal project

Codo is an AI code review service using GitHub Apps, FastAPI, Redis, and LLMs to flag potential quality and security issues in pull requests.
Repository: https://github.com/amanmulani09/codo

## Skills

- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL.
- Applied AI: LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, Google ADK, AG-UI, LangChain, LangGraph, agents, tool calling, MCP, prompt engineering, evaluation.
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Astro, React Native, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs, GraphQL.
- Cloud and delivery: GCP / Cloud Run, AWS (S3, CloudFront, Route 53), Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Grafana.
- Engineering: system design, API design, automated and integration testing, Playwright, observability, production debugging, performance optimization, code reviews.
